title: `@ocaml-index` is empty when not built from the root of a project
desc: Bug: `@ocaml-index` alias produces no output when invoked from a subdirectory, unlike other aliases.

title: Dune developer preview: ocamllsp cannot read stdlib.cmi (corrupted compiled interface)
desc: Bug: ocamllsp fails with corrupted compiled interface when using dune developer preview.

title: `dune fmt` requires `ocamlc` to be in path but does not guarantee that this is the case
desc: Bug: `dune fmt` with dev tools fails when `ocamlc` is not in PATH, even though dune should provide it.

title: Using `@ocaml-index` with vendored libraries: `Error: Conflict between the following libraries`
desc: Bug: `dune build @ocaml-index` fails with conflict errors when vendored libraries are present.

title: `dune build @fmt` exits with 1 if `ocamlformat` is not installed
desc: Dune errors out instead of gracefully skipping ocamlformat rules when no .ocamlformat file is present and ocamlformat is not installed, breaking CI workflows

title: dune fmt should not fail to format when depopt isn't available / `and` isn't lazy
desc: `dune fmt` fails when an optional dependency is not installed due to `enabled_if` evaluation, and `and` is not evaluated lazily as expected

title: @doc-new's index.html might be missing a link to `/local/index.html`
desc: Navigation links are broken in generated documentation; clicking a subindex and going "up" does not return to the expected page

title: `#use_output "dune ocaml top"` fails in a project where `dune utop` works
desc: Command fails with undefined global reference even though `dune utop` works fine in the same project; inconsistent behavior.

title: `dune build @doc` does not rebuild pages
desc: After modifying `.mli` files, `dune build @doc` does not rebuild the documentation pages and produces dangling links; broken incremental rebuild.

title: `dune-site` cannot be used in top-level REPL
desc: Loading `dune-site` in OCaml toplevel raises `Error: Reference to undefined global 'Dune_site__Dune_site_data'`

title: `dune fmt` unexpectedly triggers menhir rules
desc: `dune fmt` / `dune build @fmt` builds menhir parsers when it should not build anything

title: Dune treats warnings as errors according to the workspace `lang dune` version when building vendored packages with a more permissive `lang dune` version
desc: Warning-as-error settings from top-level `dune-project` version are applied to vendored packages instead of respecting their own `lang dune` version

title: OCaml toplevel sometimes fails to load default implementation for a virtual library
desc: `#require` in toplevel fails to load default implementation for virtual libraries, causing undefined global errors

title: `dune fmt` ignores `--disable-promotion` flag
desc: Bug: the `--disable-promotion` flag is not honored by `dune fmt`, causing unexpected file promotion

title: Error: Reference to undefined global `Build_info__Build_info_data'
desc: Bug: dune-build-info cannot be loaded in an OCaml toplevel due to missing generated module

title: Relocatable site does not work when the install directory is outside the build directory
desc: Bug: site location placeholder is replaced by absolute path regardless of --relocatable flag

title: @doc "Couldn't find the following modules: Stdlib"
desc: Bug: `dune build @doc` fails with missing module errors for Stdlib and other installed libraries

title: MDX stanza not causing dependencies to be built
desc: Bug: mdx stanza silently ignores missing files instead of raising an error or building them

title: Private modules cause missing build path (in the ocaml-merlin dump)
desc: Merlin config is missing the byte directory for libraries with private modules, causing locate failures

title: dune doesn't cleanup all .merlin files and doesn't inform user of using them
desc: Dune leaves behind stale generated .merlin files and doesn't inform users about the transition

title: interop between dune and merlin since 2.8 does not work with ppx_expect
desc: Regression: merlin queries fail with ppx_expect after upgrading from dune 2.7.1 to later versions

title: Dune doesn't generate correct .merlin file when directory path contains space
desc: Generated .merlin file has incorrect path escaping when project path contains spaces

title: Adding new formatters can break older projects
desc: Dune tries to invoke ocamlformat even without a `.ocamlformat` file, producing warnings/errors for projects that don't use it

title: dune format-dune-file doesn't respect the formatting stanza
desc: `dune format-dune-file` ignores the `(formatting (enabled_for ocaml reason))` stanza and formats dune files anyway

title: Hinted `external-lib-deps` for `dune utop` does not include Odoc
desc: The suggested `dune external-lib-deps --missing` command does not detect the missing `utop` library, giving misleading guidance

title: dune-project not formatted with @fmt
desc: `dune build @fmt` does not format the `dune-project` file, inconsistent with formatting of other dune files

title: Virtual Libraries: Dune files don't include required source entries when relying on virtual modules
desc: Generated `.merlin` files for modules depending on virtual libraries lack `S` source entries, breaking goto-location in merlin

title: Odoc: valid module name clashes cause issues
desc: Bug: dune/odoc produces "multiple rules generated" errors when two valid sub-libraries in the same package have unwrapped modules with the same name, even though they cannot be linked together

title: $ dune utop doesn't work for dune itself
desc: Bug: `dune utop` fails with "Required module `Which_program' is unavailable" error when used on the dune project itself

title: Usability issues with Dune contexts
desc: `dune exec --context=tsan` picks up the wrong binary from the default context instead of the specified one

title: Dune should respect user-specified PPX order in `(preprocess (pps ...))` stanza
desc: Dune alphabetically sorts PPX transformations, discarding user-specified order which is semantically significant

title: Promotion and cross-compilation
desc: Bug: file promotion with cross-compilation is non-deterministic; the wrong file may be promoted.

title: GCC and GLIBC supported minimums for Dune on Linux
desc: Dune fails to build on platforms where OCaml itself builds fine, due to vendored C code using C99 features without requesting C99 mode

title: Module name conflict with vendored library
desc: Vendored libraries with duplicate module names cause unexpected compilation errors; vendored libraries are not properly isolated

title: Percent forms are allowed to escape from one context to another
desc: Security/correctness issue where relative paths in percent forms can access files from other build contexts

title: All Recursive Aliases are broken in vendored directories
desc: Recursive aliases (not just test-related ones) are disabled in vendored directories, which is too aggressive

title: Inconsistent assumptions over interface when additional copy of library is present in vendored_dirs
desc: Vendored directories within installed packages leak module definitions, causing inconsistent assumption errors

title: Bug/Request `--context` should work the same with dune build and dune exec
desc: `dune build --context=foo` does not restrict to the specified context (builds all contexts), unlike `dune exec --context=foo` which works correctly

title: ppx is skipped when `(modes byte)`
desc: PPX rewriter is silently not applied when the PPX library has `(modes byte)`, causing extension points to remain unexpanded

title: Add support for `staged_pps` in `dune describe pp`
desc: `dune describe pp` does not work for staged PPXs, producing an error instead of the expected output; acknowledged as an unfixed bug.

title: dune-build-info reports wrong library version in vendored dir
desc: Library version is incorrectly reported as the git hash of the CWD repository instead of the actual library version.

title: Vendoring of foreign source trees with leading underscores
desc: Dune silently ignores directories with leading underscores in vendored foreign source trees, causing missing file errors.

title: Build failing due to existence of broken symbolic link (unused in build)
desc: Dune fails the build when a broken symlink exists in vendored sources even though it is not used by the build

title: Dune tests are being executed in unexpected dir while vendoring
desc: Tests in vendored projects execute from `%{workspace_root}` instead of the vendored `%{project_root}`

title: Rule collision when multiple vendored projects contain executables with matching names
desc: Dune errors with "Multiple rules generated" when two vendored packages both contain executables with the same public name

title: Warnings leak through `vendored_dirs` subpath
desc: Bug: nested vendored directories still emit warnings that should be suppressed

title: dune 3.0 cannot find file through relative path during ppx preprocessing
desc: Bug: regression in dune 3.0+ where ppx_blob can no longer find files via relative paths that worked in earlier versions

title: Bad ppx annotations are not reported
desc: Bug: invalid/unused ppx annotations are silently ignored instead of producing errors

title: ppxs are built in the target context in cross-compilation settings
desc: PPX libraries are incorrectly built in the target context instead of the host context during cross-compilation, causing build failures

title: Undesired conflict between vendored library and public library by the same name
desc: Dune incorrectly reports a conflict when a vendored library has the same name as an external one used by a different dependency

title: Explicit executable dependencies and cross-compilation
desc: Explicit .exe dependencies in rules resolve to cross-compiled workspace instead of host context, breaking cross-compilation

title: Dune finds non existing library conflict without (implicit_transitive_deps false)
desc: Dune incorrectly detects a library conflict that doesn't actually exist in certain vendoring scenarios

title: "The module X is an alias for module Y.X, which is missing" when X comes from a virtual library
desc: Aliased modules from virtual libraries produce incorrect errors when installed/pinned (works when vendored)

title: "Unknown constructor vendored_dirs" when using OCaml syntax
desc: `vendored_dirs` works in static dune files but fails with "Unknown constructor" when using OCaml (tuareg) syntax

title: Fl_dynload.load_packages in a PPX
desc: `findlib_initl.ml-gen` is not generated for PPX preprocessors, so `Fl_dynload.load_packages` fails in PPX rewriters

title: Recursive alias in vendored directories are not well defined
desc: `@all` and `@@all` behave inconsistently in vendored directories

title: Configurator does not have access to C flags set in (env)
desc: Bug: configurator ignores C flags set in workspace env stanza, producing incorrect build configuration results in multi-context workspaces
